<thought>The carbon NMR shows three signals in the aromatic region (≈161, 144, 130 ppm). Such a pattern (three distinct aromatic carbon signals) is typical for a para‑disubstituted benzene ring, which contains six aromatic carbons that are symmetry‑equivalent in pairs. Therefore the molecule has six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
